verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents tracking of users' own CRON jobs (heartbeat monitoring), on-call rotation schedules, and monitors that check URLs at intervals. None of these lets a user schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows to run in the product. Monitoring someone else's cron, managing who is on call, and periodic uptime checks are adjacent features, not a job or workflow scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
